title: On $R$-sequenceability of odd ordered groups
summary: We study the $R$-sequenceability of finite groups of odd order. Building on the classical theory of $R^*$-sequences and orthomorphisms, we explore two tools: the notion of $R^{**}$-sequenceability, a strengthening of $R^*$-sequenceability tailored for inductive arguments over normal subgroups with cyclic quotients, and the \textit{odd cycle index} $τ(G)$, which measures how many orthomorphisms are required to generate a full cycle together with an involution.
